# Carrier answers (PT4)

Written for Themi's tests in the shapes the carriers publish, not recorded from their
services: UPS's `Tracking.yaml` (github.com/UPS-API/api-documentation, `TrackApiResponse`)
and USPS's Tracking v3r2 OpenAPI file (developers.usps.com, `TrackingDetail`). Values are
made up; `NUMBER` is replaced by the tracking number asked about. The status words
("Out For Delivery Today", "Delivered, Front Door/Porch") are the kind each carrier shows
on its own tracking pages.
